deck: New tariffs for 14 partners, a blast in Iowa, mines in Hormuz — and a Pakistani astronaut boards Tiangong

hero.headline: US proposes new tariffs on 14 partners, China facing 20%
hero.summary: The Trump administration proposed duties after an eight-month probe into excess factory capacity: 20% on China, 15% on the EU, Japan, South Korea, Switzerland and Taiwan, 18% on five Asian exporters, 10% on Singapore, up to 35% on Vietnam without a deal. Beijing called it a 'false issue'; hearings in January.

rail.headline: Army detonates 9,700 lb of lead azide in Iowa
rail.summary: Two booms around 09:00 CST ended days of delays and court fights. Middletown had evacuated; EPA monitors found zero lead in the air an hour later.

rail.headline: Iran says two tankers hit mines off Hormuz
rail.kicker: WAR AT SEA · STRAIT OF HORMUZ
rail.summary: Two tankers struck naval mines, exploded and caught fire early Wednesday, Iran's Guards Navy said. No vessel names were given; the claim is unverified.
